en: It's me, Little Lamb.
zh: 是我，小羊。
ja: 僕だよ、リトル・ラム。
local: It's me, Little Lamb.
ja_pron: Boku da yo, Ritoru Ramu.
native: It's me, Little Lamb.

en: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.
zh: 今晚，我有一個非常特別的故事要和你分享。
ja: 今夜、とても特別な話を君に伝えたいんだ。
local: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.
ja_pron: Kon'ya, totemo tokubetsu na hanashi o kimi ni tsutaetain da.
native: Tonight, I have a very special story to share with you.

en: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.
zh: 這是關於愛、勇氣，以及任何人曾經給予過的最美好的禮物。
ja: それは愛と勇気、そして誰もがかつて受け取った中で最も素晴らしい贈り物の話だよ。
local: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.
ja_pron: Sore wa ai to yūki, soshite dare mo ga katsute uketotta naka de mottomo subarashii okurimono no hanashi da yo.
native: It's about love, courage, and the most wonderful gift anyone has ever given.

en: It's the true story of Easter.
zh: 這是真正的復活節故事。
ja: これはイースターの本当の物語だよ。
local: It's the true story of Easter.
ja_pron: Kore wa Īsutā no hontō no monogatari da yo.
native: It's the true story of Easter.

en: Are you ready?
zh: 你準備好了嗎？
ja: 準備はいい？
local: Are you ready?
ja_pron: Junbi wa ii?
native: Are you ready?

en: Let's begin.
zh: 讓我們開始吧。
ja: さあ、始めよう。
local: Let's begin.
ja_pron: Sā, hajimeyō.
native: Let's begin.

en: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.
zh: 有一天，耶穌騎著一頭小驢子進入了耶路撒冷城。
ja: ある日、イエスは小さなロバに乗ってエルサレムの街に入った。
local: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.
ja_pron: Aru hi, Iesu wa chiisana roba ni notte Erusaremu no machi ni haitta.
native: One day, Jesus rode into the city of Jerusalem on a little donkey.

en: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,
zh: 人群聚集，揮舞著棕櫚枝，大聲呼喊，
ja: 群衆が集まり、ヤシの枝を振りながら叫んだ、
local: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,
ja_pron: Gunshū ga atsumari, yashi no eda o furinagara sakenda,
native: Crowds gathered waving palm branches and shouting,

en: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.
zh: 哦，聖者，他們看到他非常高興。
ja: ああ、聖なる方、彼らは彼を見ることができてとても嬉しかった。
local: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.
ja_pron: Ā, seinaru kata, karera wa kare o miru koto ga dekite totemo ureshikatta.
native: Oh, Santa, they were so happy to see him.

en: Jesus was their king.
zh: 耶穌是他們的王。
ja: イエスは彼らの王だった。
local: Jesus was their king.
ja_pron: Iesu wa karera no ō datta.
native: Jesus was their king.

en: Come to bring peace and love.
zh: 來帶來和平與愛。
ja: 平和と愛をもたらすために来たんだ。
local: Come to bring peace and love.
ja_pron: Heiwa to ai o motarasu tame ni kitan da.
native: Come to bring peace and love.

en: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.
zh: 那週晚些時候，耶穌和他最親密的朋友們共進了一頓特別的晚餐。
ja: その週の後半、イエスは最も親しい友人たちと特別な夕食をとった。
local: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.
ja_pron: Sono shū no kōhan, Iesu wa mottomo shitashii yūjin-tachi to tokubetsu na yūshoku o totta.
native: Later that week, Jesus had a special dinner with his closest friends.

en: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,
zh: 他掰開餅，分享杯子，說，
ja: 彼はパンを割り、杯を分け合いながら言った、
local: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,
ja_pron: Kare wa pan o wari, sakazuki o wakeainagara itta,
native: He broke bread and shared a cup, saying,

en: This is my body.
zh: 這是我的身體。
ja: これは私の体です。
local: This is my body.
ja_pron: Kore wa watashi no karada desu.
native: This is my body.

en: And this is my blood, given for you.
zh: 這是我的血，為你們而流。
ja: そしてこれはあなたたちのために流す私の血です。
local: And this is my blood, given for you.
ja_pron: Soshite kore wa anata-tachi no tame ni nagasu watashi no chi desu.
native: And this is my blood, given for you.

en: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.
zh: 耶穌知道有件非常艱難的事即將發生。
ja: イエスはとても辛いことが起ころうとしているのを知っていた。
local: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.
ja_pron: Iesu wa totemo tsurai koto ga okorou to shite iru no o shitte ita.
native: Jesus knew something very hard was about to happen.

en: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.
zh: 但他想讓朋友們知道他有多愛他們。
ja: でも彼は友達にどれだけ愛しているかを知ってほしかった。
local: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.
ja_pron: Demo kare wa tomodachi ni dore dake aishite iru ka o shitte hoshikatta.
native: But he wanted his friends to know how much he loved them.

en: Then Jesus gave them a promise.
zh: 然後耶穌給了他們一個承諾。
ja: それからイエスは彼らに約束をした。
local: Then Jesus gave them a promise.
ja_pron: Sorekara Iesu wa karera ni yakusoku o shita.
native: Then Jesus gave them a promise.

en: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.
zh: 他說，我會離開一會兒，但不要害怕。
ja: 彼は言った、しばらくの間いなくなるけど、怖がらないでね。
local: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.
ja_pron: Kare wa itta, shibaraku no aida inakunaru kedo, kowagaranaide ne.
native: He said, I will go away for a little while, but don't be afraid.

en: I will come back to life again.
zh: 我會再次復活。
ja: また生き返るよ。
local: I will come back to life again.
ja_pron: Mata ikikaeru yo.
native: I will come back to life again.

en: His friends didn't fully understand.
zh: 他的朋友們並不完全理解。
ja: 彼の友達は完全には理解できなかった。
local: His friends didn't fully understand.
ja_pron: Kare no tomodachi wa kanzen ni wa rikai dekinakatta.
native: His friends didn't fully understand.

en: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.
zh: 但耶穌分享了一個很快會改變世界的希望。
ja: でもイエスは、すぐに世界を変える希望を分かち合っていた。
local: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.
ja_pron: Demo Iesu wa, sugu ni sekai o kaeru kibō o wakachiatte ita.
native: But Jesus was sharing a hope that would soon change the world.

en: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.
zh: 那天晚上，耶穌去了安靜的花園祈禱。
ja: その夜、イエスは静かな庭に行って祈った。
local: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.
ja_pron: Sono yoru, Iesu wa shizuka na niwa ni itte inotta.
native: That night, Jesus went to a quiet garden to pray.

en: He felt sad and afraid.
zh: 他感到悲傷和害怕。
ja: 彼は悲しくて怖かった。
local: He felt sad and afraid.
ja_pron: Kare wa kanashikute kowakatta.
native: He felt sad and afraid.

en: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.
zh: 他向上帝祈求力量，因為他知道將要發生什麼。
ja: 彼は神に力を求めた、何が起こるか知っていたから。
local: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.
ja_pron: Kare wa kami ni chikara o motometa, nani ga okoru ka shitte ita kara.
native: He asked God for strength because he knew what was coming.

en: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.
zh: 耶穌選擇服從，儘管這很艱難。
ja: イエスは従うことを選んだ、たとえそれが辛くても。
local: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.
ja_pron: Iesu wa shitagau koto o eranda, tatoe sore ga tsurakute mo.
native: Jesus chose to obey, even though it would be hard.

en: Because he loves us so much.
zh: 因為他非常愛我們。
ja: それは彼が私たちをとても愛しているからだ。
local: Because he loves us so much.
ja_pron: Sore wa kare ga watashitachi o totemo aishite iru kara da.
native: Because he loves us so much.

en: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.
zh: 當耶穌祈禱時，一群士兵來到了花園。
ja: イエスが祈っている間に、兵士の一団が庭にやって来た。
local: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.
ja_pron: Iesu ga inotte iru aida ni, heishi no ichidan ga niwa ni yatte kita.
native: While Jesus prayed, a group of soldiers came to the garden.

en: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.
zh: 他們由一個名叫猶大的男子帶領，他是耶穌的追隨者之一。
ja: 彼らはユダという男に率いられていた。彼はイエスの弟子の一人だった。
local: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.
ja_pron: Karera wa Yuda to iu otoko ni hikiirarete ita. Kare wa Iesu no deshi no hitori datta.
native: They were led by a man named Judas, one of Jesus' own followers.

en: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.
zh: 猶大選擇背叛耶穌，並幫助那些對他生氣的領導者。
ja: ユダはイエスを裏切ることを選び、彼に怒っている指導者たちを助けた。
local: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.
ja_pron: Yuda wa Iesu o uragiru koto o erabi, kare ni okotte iru shidōsha-tachi o tasuketa.
native: Judas had chosen to betray Jesus and helped the leaders who were angry with him.

en: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.
zh: 他們不相信耶穌是上帝的兒子。
ja: 彼らはイエスが神の子だとは信じていなかった。
local: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.
ja_pron: Karera wa Iesu ga kami no ko da to wa shinjite inakatta.
native: They didn't believe Jesus was the son of God.

en: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.
zh: 他們害怕他所教導的愛與真理。
ja: そして彼が教えた愛と真実を恐れていた。
local: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.
ja_pron: Soshite kare ga oshieta ai to shinjitsu o osorete ita.
native: And they were afraid of the love and truth he taught.

en: So they had him arrested.
zh: 所以他們逮捕了他。
ja: だから彼らはイエスを逮捕した。
local: So they had him arrested.
ja_pron: Dakara karera wa Iesu o taiho shita.
native: So they had him arrested.

en: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.
zh: 儘管耶穌什麼錯都沒有犯。
ja: イエスは何も悪いことをしていなかったのに。
local: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.
ja_pron: Iesu wa nanimo warui koto o shite inakatta noni.
native: Even though Jesus had done nothing wrong.

en: But Jesus didn't run away.
zh: 但耶穌沒有逃跑。
ja: しかしイエスは逃げなかった。
local: But Jesus didn't run away.
ja_pron: Shikashi Iesu wa nigenakatta.
native: But Jesus didn't run away.

en: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.
zh: 他知道這是上帝拯救世界計劃的一部分。
ja: これは世界を救う神の計画の一部だと知っていた。
local: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.
ja_pron: Kore wa sekai o sukuu kami no keikaku no ichibu da to shitte ita.
native: He knew this was part of God's plan to save the world.

en: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.
zh: 耶穌被帶到一個叫髑髏地的地方，並被釘在十字架上。
ja: イエスはカルバリーと呼ばれる場所に連れて行かれ、十字架にかけられた。
local: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.
ja_pron: Iesu wa Karubarī to yobareru basho ni tsurete ikare, jūjika ni kakerareta.
native: Jesus was taken to a place called Calvary, where he was put on a cross.

en: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,
zh: 儘管他有能力阻止一切，耶穌選擇留下，
ja: すべてを止める力があったのに、イエスはとどまることを選んだ、
local: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,
ja_pron: Subete o tomeru chikara ga atta noni, Iesu wa todomaru koto o eranda,
native: Even though he had the power to stop everything, Jesus chose to stay,

en: because he was rescuing us.
zh: 因為他在拯救我們。
ja: それは彼が私たちを救っていたからだ。
local: because he was rescuing us.
ja_pron: Sore wa kare ga watashitachi o sukutte ita kara da.
native: because he was rescuing us.

en: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.
zh: 他承擔了人們所做過和將來可能做的所有錯事的懲罰。
ja: 彼は人々が犯したすべての罪とこれから犯すかもしれない罪の罰を受けた。
local: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.
ja_pron: Kare wa hitobito ga okashita subete no tsumi to kore kara okasu kamoshirenai tsumi no batsu o uketa.
native: He took the punishment for all the wrong things people had done and would ever do.

en: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.
zh: 耶穌原諒了傷害他的人。
ja: イエスは自分を傷つけた人々を許した。
local: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.
ja_pron: Iesu wa jibun o kizutsuketa hitobito o yurushita.
native: Jesus forgave the people who hurt him.

en: He looked at the sky and said,
zh: 他望向天空說，
ja: 彼は空を見上げて言った、
local: He looked at the sky and said,
ja_pron: Kare wa sora o miagete itta,
native: He looked at the sky and said,

en: Father, I place my life in your hands.
zh: 父啊，我將我的生命交在你手中。
ja: 父よ、私の命をあなたの手に委ねます。
local: Father, I place my life in your hands.
ja_pron: Chichi yo, watashi no inochi o anata no te ni yudane masu.
native: Father, I place my life in your hands.

en: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.
zh: 然後耶穌斷了最後一口氣，一切變得寂靜。
ja: そしてイエスは最後の息を引き取り、すべてが静かになった。
local: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.
ja_pron: Soshite Iesu wa saigo no iki o hikitori, subete ga shizuka ni natta.
native: Then Jesus took his last breath and everything grew quiet.

en: But this was not the end.
zh: 但這不是結束。
ja: しかし、これは終わりではなかった。
local: But this was not the end.
ja_pron: Shikashi, kore wa owari de wa nakatta.
native: But this was not the end.

en: Jesus had made a promise.
zh: 耶穌曾經做出承諾。
ja: イエスは約束をしていた。
local: Jesus had made a promise.
ja_pron: Iesu wa yakusoku o shite ita.
native: Jesus had made a promise.

en: I will rise again.
zh: 我會再次復活。
ja: 私はまたよみがえる。
local: I will rise again.
ja_pron: Watashi wa mata yomigaeru.
native: I will rise again.

en: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.
zh: 即使在寂靜中，上帝的愛的計劃還沒有結束。
ja: 静けさの中でも、神の愛の計画は終わっていなかった。
local: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.
ja_pron: Shizukesa no naka demo, kami no ai no keikaku wa owatte inakatta.
native: And even in the stillness, God's plan of love wasn't over.

en: Jesus' friends were very sad.
zh: 耶穌的朋友們非常難過。
ja: イエスの友達はとても悲しんでいた。
local: Jesus' friends were very sad.
ja_pron: Iesu no tomodachi wa totemo kanashinde ita.
native: Jesus' friends were very sad.

en: They gently placed his body in a tomb.
zh: 他們輕輕地把他的身體放進墳墓。
ja: 彼らは優しく彼の体を墓に安置した。
local: They gently placed his body in a tomb.
ja_pron: Karera wa yasashiku kare no karada o haka ni anchi shita.
native: They gently placed his body in a tomb.

en: And a big stone was rolled in front.
zh: 並且一塊大石頭被滾到前面。
ja: そして大きな石が前に転がされた。
local: And a big stone was rolled in front.
ja_pron: Soshite ōkina ishi ga mae ni korogasareta.
native: And a big stone was rolled in front.

en: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.
zh: 但在星期天清晨，發生了令人驚奇的事。
ja: しかし日曜の早朝、驚くべきことが起こった。
local: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.
ja_pron: Shikashi nichiyō no sōchō, odorokubeki koto ga okotta.
native: But early on Sunday morning, something amazing happened.

en: An angel came and rolled the stone away.
zh: 一位天使來了，把石頭滾開了。
ja: 天使が来て石を転がしてどけた。
local: An angel came and rolled the stone away.
ja_pron: Tenshi ga kite ishi o korogashite doketa.
native: An angel came and rolled the stone away.

en: The tomb was empty.
zh: 墳墓是空的。
ja: 墓は空っぽだった。
local: The tomb was empty.
ja_pron: Haka wa karappo datta.
native: The tomb was empty.

en: Jesus wasn't there.
zh: 耶穌不在那裡。
ja: イエスはいなかった。
local: Jesus wasn't there.
ja_pron: Iesu wa inakatta.
native: Jesus wasn't there.

en: He had come back to life just like he promised.
zh: 他如同承諾的那樣復活了。
ja: 彼は約束通りに生き返った。
local: He had come back to life just like he promised.
ja_pron: Kare wa yakusoku dōri ni ikikaetta.
native: He had come back to life just like he promised.

en: The angel told them,
zh: 天使告訴他們，
ja: 天使は彼らに言った、
local: The angel told them,
ja_pron: Tenshi wa karera ni itta,
native: The angel told them,

en: Jesus is alive.
zh: 耶穌活著。
ja: イエスは生きている。
local: Jesus is alive.
ja_pron: Iesu wa ikite iru.
native: Jesus is alive.

en: Joy filled their hearts.
zh: 喜悅充滿了他們的心。
ja: 喜びが彼らの心を満たした。
local: Joy filled their hearts.
ja_pron: Yorokobi ga karera no kokoro o mitashita.
native: Joy filled their hearts.

en: Jesus had won.
zh: 耶穌勝利了。
ja: イエスは勝利した。
local: Jesus had won.
ja_pron: Iesu wa shōri shita.
native: Jesus had won.

en: His love was stronger than death.
zh: 他的愛比死亡更強大。
ja: 彼の愛は死よりも強かった。
local: His love was stronger than death.
ja_pron: Kare no ai wa shi yori mo tsuyokatta.
native: His love was stronger than death.

en: And because of that,
zh: 正因如此，
ja: そしてそのために、
local: And because of that,
ja_pron: Soshite sono tame ni,
native: And because of that,

en: we never have to be afraid.
zh: 我們永遠不必害怕。
ja: 私たちは決して怖がる必要はない。
local: we never have to be afraid.
ja_pron: Watashitachi wa kesshite kowagaru hitsuyō wa nai.
native: we never have to be afraid.

en: Jesus appeared to his friends.
zh: 耶穌向他的朋友顯現。
ja: イエスは友達に現れた。
local: Jesus appeared to his friends.
ja_pron: Iesu wa tomodachi ni arawareta.
native: Jesus appeared to his friends.

en: To show them he was truly alive.
zh: 向他們展示他確實活著。
ja: 彼が本当に生きていることを示すために。
local: To show them he was truly alive.
ja_pron: Kare ga hontō ni ikite iru koto o shimesu tame ni.
native: To show them he was truly alive.

en: He gave them hope and peace.
zh: 他給了他們希望與平安。
ja: 彼は彼らに希望と平和を与えた。
local: He gave them hope and peace.
ja_pron: Kare wa karera ni kibō to heiwa o ataeta.
native: He gave them hope and peace.

en: And then one day he returned to heaven
zh: 然後有一天他回到了天堂，
ja: そしてある日、彼は天に帰った。
local: And then one day he returned to heaven
ja_pron: Soshite aru hi, kare wa ten ni kaetta.
native: And then one day he returned to heaven

en: where he watches over us still.
zh: 他仍然在那裡守護著我們。
ja: そこで今も私たちを見守っている。
local: where he watches over us still.
ja_pron: Soko de ima mo watashitachi o mimamotte iru.
native: where he watches over us still.

en: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.
zh: 這就是復活節的故事，我親愛的朋友。
ja: それがイースターの物語だよ、親愛なる友よ。
local: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.
ja_pron: Sore ga Īsutā no monogatari da yo, shin'aina tomo yo.
native: And that's the Easter story, my dear friend.

en: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.
zh: 耶穌如此愛我們，以至於他獻出生命來拯救我們。
ja: イエスは私たちをとても愛して、命を捧げて救ってくれた。
local: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.
ja_pron: Iesu wa watashitachi o totemo aishite, inochi o sasagete sukutte kureta.
native: Jesus loved us so much that he gave his life to save us.

en: And when everything seems sad and still,
zh: 當一切看起來悲傷而寂靜時，
ja: すべてが悲しく静かに見えるときでも、
local: And when everything seems sad and still,
ja_pron: Subete ga kanashiku shizuka ni mieru toki demo,
native: And when everything seems sad and still,

en: he came back just like he promised.
zh: 他如同承諾的那樣回來了。
ja: 彼は約束通りに戻ってきた。
local: he came back just like he promised.
ja_pron: Kare wa yakusoku dōri ni modotte kita.
native: he came back just like he promised.

en: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.
zh: 耶穌活著，他永遠與我們同在。
ja: イエスは生きていて、いつも私たちと一緒にいる。
local: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.
ja_pron: Iesu wa ikite ite, itsumo watashitachi to issho ni iru.
native: Jesus is alive and he's always with us.

en: That means we're never alone.
zh: 這意味著我們永遠不孤單。
ja: それは私たちが決して一人ではないということだ。
local: That means we're never alone.
ja_pron: Sore wa watashitachi ga kesshite hitori de wa nai to iu koto da.
native: That means we're never alone.

en: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.
zh: 在我們睡覺前，讓我們一起禱告。
ja: 寝る前に、一緒にお祈りしよう。
local: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.
ja_pron: Neru mae ni, issho ni oinori shiyō.
native: Before we go to sleep, let's say our prayers.

en: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.
zh: 親愛的耶穌，謝謝你如此愛我。
ja: 親愛なるイエス様、私をこんなに愛してくれてありがとう。
local: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.
ja_pron: Shin'aina Iesu-sama, watashi o konna ni aishite kurete arigatō.
native: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much.

en: Thank you for being brave and kind.
zh: 謝謝你勇敢又善良。
ja: 勇敢で優しいあなたに感謝します。
local: Thank you for being brave and kind.
ja_pron: Yūkan de yasashii anata ni kansha shimasu.
native: Thank you for being brave and kind.

en: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.
zh: 我很高興你活著並永遠與我同在。
ja: あなたが生きていて、いつもそばにいてくれて本当に嬉しい。
local: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.
ja_pron: Anata ga ikite ite, itsumo soba ni ite kurete hontō ni ureshii.
native: I'm so glad you are alive and with me always.

en: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.
zh: 請幫助我今晚在你的平安中安睡。
ja: 今夜、あなたの平和の中で眠れるよう助けてください。
local: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.
ja_pron: Kon'ya, anata no heiwa no naka de nemureru yō tasukete kudasai.
native: Help me sleep in your peace tonight.

en: Amen.
zh: 阿門。
ja: アーメン。
local: Amen.
native: Amen.
